'''Fort Phalanx''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military outpost located on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was [[Battle for Darth Vengean's flagship|assaulted]] by [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] in his pursuit of the Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Monk (Human)|Monk]].
